description: Update /docs page and DocsSidebar to document all new endpoints. Independent of FEATs 001-003 in terms of code (no imports from new files), but logically follows them since it documents what they produce. The docs page uses a dynamic baseUrl derived from request headers — maintain this pattern throughout.
steps: 1. Read src/app/api/v1/nearby-for-report/route.ts to understand its request/response shape before writing docs for it.

2. In src/components/docs/sidebar.tsx: in the sections array, find the entry with id='endpoints' and add four children to its children array (after the existing three): { id: 'analyze', label: 'POST /analyze' }, { id: 'analyze-image', label: 'POST /analyze-image' }, { id: 'nearby-for-report', label: 'POST /nearby-for-report' }, { id: 'escalation-consent', label: 'POST /escalation/:id/consent' }.

3. In src/app/docs/page.tsx, after the existing match-by-diagnosis EndpointSection, add a new EndpointSection with id='analyze', method='POST', path='/api/v1/analyze', summary='Full ENT symptom analysis', description='Submit patient symptoms for comprehensive ENT analysis. Uses dataset matching as primary method; falls back to Gemini AI when dataset confidence is low. Automatically detects complex cases and flags them for specialist review.' Include: (a) request fields table covering all 12 fields (symptoms, affectedArea, duration, onsetPattern, age, additionalContext, latitude, longitude, place, includeNearby, radiusKm, limit); (b) a note box explaining the AI fallback trigger (localMatches.length === 0 OR score < 30); (c) analysis.method values table (dataset_match, ai_assisted, ai_full_analysis, fallback); (d) aiStatus error codes table (AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, AI_TIMEOUT, AI_UNAVAILABLE, AI_ERROR); (e) escalation field explanation; (f) example request and response JSON using `baseUrl` variable for URLs.

4. In src/app/docs/page.tsx, add EndpointSection id='analyze-image', method='POST', path='/api/v1/analyze-image'. Include: (a) consent notice callout box; (b) base64 format explanation (data URL prefix accepted, stripped before processing); (c) 4MB size limit note; (d) imageType values (ear, nose, throat, general); (e) request fields table; (f) example request/response JSON.

5. In src/app/docs/page.tsx, add EndpointSection id='nearby-for-report', method='POST', path='/api/v1/nearby-for-report'. Document based on actual route file content read in step 1. Include request fields, example request/response.

6. In src/app/docs/page.tsx, add EndpointSection id='escalation-consent', method='POST', path='/api/v1/escalation/:id/consent'. Include: (a) explanation of the consent flow (caseId comes from /analyze escalation.caseId); (b) request fields table (consent: boolean, email?: string); (c) behavior: consent=true saves email and marks case as consented; consent=false closes the case; (d) example request/response.
acceptance_criteria: DocsSidebar sections array has four new children under endpoints
Docs page has four new EndpointSection blocks with correct ids matching sidebar
All code examples in new sections use the dynamic baseUrl variable, not hardcoded URLs
Consent notice text appears in the analyze-image section

Consent notice callout present in analyze-image section. npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
